# Keys to the old workshop

Jo has three sets of workshop keys and everyone phones her when the shutter sticks. The key register is accurate, yet nobody else knows which breaker to reset. We are calling the harbour archive a community project while leaving its practical memory with one volunteer. Write the opening procedure with Jo present, then have someone else actually open the room. [[Volunteer handbook]] should record the awkward bits, not just the address.
